The company has used an accounting software for maintaining its books of account which has a feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility, but the same was not operated throughout the year for all relevant transactions recorded in the software.
Company has incurred cash losses of Rs. 163.11 lakhs in the current financial year and Rs NIL during the immediately preceding year.
There has been resignation of the statutory auditors during the year and there were no issues, objections or concerns raised by the outgoing auditors.
Outstanding loan amounting to Rs 19.30 lakhs is overdue for more than 90 days.
Undisputed statutory dues outstanding for more than six months: TDS interest/penalty as per Traces Rs 0.22 lakhs, Income Tax Demand Rs 0.30 lakhs.

Emphasis of Matter: Nibe Maritime Private Limited, a subsidiary, has negative networth and its current liabilities exceed its current assets as at 31 March 2026, indicating a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. However, the financial statements of the subsidiary have been prepared on a going concern basis considering management's assessment of future business prospects, expected cash flows from ongoing and proposed projects, and continued financial support from the promoters/group entities. Opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

outlook.statement: Government of India allocated Rs 6,81,210 crore to Ministry of Defence in FY 2025-26 (9.53% increase). India's defence production reached Rs 1.78 lakh crore (15.6% YoY growth). Record defence exports of Rs 38,424 crore. FY 2025-26 designated as 'Year of Reforms'. Atmanirbhar Bharat programme facilitating indigenisation. PLI Scheme to stimulate domestic defence manufacturing.
The company is poised to become a key player in the defense sector, contributing to national security and global defense markets through state-of-the-art manufacturing and turnkey solutions.
